crossRefs.note: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me…
The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold…

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

translations.web: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
translations.bsb: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.
translations.kjv: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
translations.asv: Ye have sent unto John, and he hath borne witness unto the truth.
